integrity: The proof starts from the published minimal facet system, reduces global Chebyshev optimization to diagonal centers by permutation averaging, derives the normalized intersection value for every facet size, and proves that this size profile has a single interior maximum, leaving only two endpoint barriers. Uniqueness and the exact contact sets are then forced by the active shifted facets.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the two-parameter generalized parking-function polytopes in their standard Euclidean coordinate realization. It does not cover arbitrary parameter vectors or determine enclosing spheres or extremal ellipsoids. The transition formula uses the arithmetic-progression structure of the source facet offsets.
title: Generalized parking-function polytopes have a two-phase Euclidean inball
